name: agenthydra
description: AgentHydra Community: every local AI coding session (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) in one window and one dashboard. A community fork of AgentHydra.
author: AgentHydra Community contributors

scripts.//check:deep: The everything lane, run before a release and by nobody in a hurry: check, every package typecheck, then test:full (25+ minutes of Python unittest included). .githooks/pre-push runs it for a release tag (v*.*.*) only when gh cannot confirm a green ci.yml run on the tagged commit, since every lane here is a ci.yml step; with that confirmation it runs nothing more. It exists so the orchestrator suites are reachable from a gate lane by name, which is how the Architect decides a test script verifies anything.
scripts.check:deep: bun run check && bun run typecheck && bun run test:full
scripts.//audit:public: The public-safety gate, scripts/audit-public.mjs. With no arguments it checks the import commit at the root of this repository's history (upstream's tree at 3a65ba8e, its last MIT commit, with no parent), then reads the tree at HEAD and every commit after it. .githooks/check-public-push.mjs runs its --push mode on every push, and .github/workflows/audit-public.yml runs the tree and history audits on every push and pull request.
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd server typecheck && bun run --cwd orchestrator/web typecheck && bun run --cwd orchestrator/server typecheck
scripts.//test: `test` is the everyday lane (seconds): the bun suites at the root and orchestrator/server's (the remote gateway). `test:full` adds the Python toolbox's own unittest discover (test:orchestrator), which takes 25+ minutes on this box; CI runs that same discover step in its own job (.github/workflows/ci.yml), so nothing verifies nothing. Wired 2026-09-15 for the Architect's verification-coverage-reachability check, which reads package.json lanes and not workflows.
scripts.test: bun test --parallel=4 && bun run --cwd orchestrator/server test
scripts.test:full: bun run test && bun run test:orchestrator
scripts.//save:bundle: ONLY when the owner has said to sweep the whole dirty tree. Commits everything as one `wip: bundle` commit whose message names every file taken from another session (Mine:/Swept:), so the peer finds out from the log. Never --no-verify; the commit-msg hook checks the list.
